preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The number of edges m is non-negative and does not exceed the maximum possible edges for a simple graph.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid vertices within the range [1, n] and no self-loops exist.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges))
preconditions.description: The graph contains no multiple edges between the same pair of vertices.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'FHTAGN!\n' if (is_connected(n, edges) and m == n and has_cycle(n, edges)) else 'NO\n'
postconditions.description: Output 'FHTAGN!' if the graph is connected, has exactly n edges, and contains at least one cycle; otherwise output 'NO'.
